snapshot.title: Job board contractor UI
snapshot.description: Contractor panel as a job board: all available missions visible simultaneously for comparison and selection.

acceptanceCriteria.text: All unlocked contractors' missions visible on one screen
Missions show: contractor name, mineral required, quantity, payout, mission type
Market comparison legible (contractor premium vs open market)
Contractor cooldown status shown inline
Sorting or filtering by payout/type

Legend row + note about selecting in Launchpad.
